un_aggression.speaker: un
un_aggression.title: Security Council: condemn $NAME
un_aggression.text: A resolution demands $NAME withdraw from $B and threatens sanctions. Your vote, or your veto, decides it.

un_famine.speaker: un
un_famine.title: Security Council: famine relief for $NAME
un_famine.text: Members want a UN relief operation in $NAME. It needs US money and logistics to work.

un_peacekeeping.speaker: un
un_peacekeeping.title: Security Council: peacekeepers for $NAME
un_peacekeeping.text: A resolution would send blue-helmet peacekeepers into the civil war in $NAME, with US airlift support.

un_terror.speaker: un
un_terror.title: Security Council: sanctions on $NAME
un_terror.text: A resolution would impose UN sanctions on $NAME for sheltering armed groups that attack civilians abroad.

pact_test.speaker: nsa
pact_test.title: $NAME invades our treaty ally $B
pact_test.text: $B has invoked our defence pact. Every ally and every rival is watching what the United States does next.

election_review.speaker: chief
election_review.title: Election night: you win
election_review.text: Congratulations, Mr. President. You have a second term. The panel's verdict on your first is on your desk.

protests.speaker: chief
protests.title: Mass protests in Washington
protests.text: Hundreds of thousands are in the streets demanding that you restore the freedoms you have suspended. The crowds grow every night, and the networks are covering nothing else.

impeach.speaker: chief
impeach.title: Articles of impeachment
impeach.text: The House has drafted articles of impeachment for abuse of power. My whip count is grim, Mr. President. We need to decide how this ends.

generals.speaker: defense
generals.title: The generals are restless
generals.text: Senior commanders are meeting without me. Some of them talk openly about restoring constitutional order. I can't promise you the chain of command holds.

attempt.speaker: chief
attempt.title: Shots fired at the motorcade
attempt.text: An assassin opened fire on your motorcade this morning. The Secret Service got you out, but an agent was wounded. The country is shaken and waiting to hear from you.

leader_killed.speaker: cia
leader_killed.title: The leader of $NAME has been assassinated
leader_killed.text: Gunmen killed the head of government of $NAME a few hours ago. The capital is locked down and rival factions are already moving. We have a narrow window to shape what comes next.

opening_classic_1990.speaker: chief
opening_classic_1990.title: Your first morning in the Oval Office
opening_classic_1990.text: Good morning, and welcome to the desk. The Cold War is ending and nobody knows what comes next. The cabinet wants to know where you will put your first hundred days.

opening_modern_2026.speaker: chief
opening_modern_2026.title: Your first morning in the Oval Office
opening_modern_2026.text: Good morning, and welcome to the desk. There is a war in Europe, a rival in the Pacific and a deficit at home. The cabinet wants to know where you will put your first hundred days.
